## Profile

Anuj Rastogi is a developer at IntelligenceX and a B.Tech Computer Science graduate. His work spans Python, Django, FastAPI, MERN stack development, REST API architecture, Power BI, Excel, cybersecurity analytics, Nmap, Burp Suite, and automated website analysis.

## Key Areas

- Full-stack engineering with Python, Django, FastAPI, React, Node.js, Express, and MongoDB
- Data analytics and business intelligence with Power BI and Excel
- Security and website auditing with Lighthouse, Playwright, axe-core, SSL/TLS checks, Nmap, and Burp Suite
- AI-assisted threat intelligence, automation, and technical reporting
